snippet.title: Everything You Know About Skills IS OUTDATED
snippet.description:
🚀 Join the Agentic Academy: https://skool.com/scrapes
👀 Be the brand AI recommends: https://dub.sh/rankspot-yt
Get the Skill Audit Prompt from this video in the community: https://skool.com/scrapesai
Anthropic’s skill building best practices: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/agents-and-tools/agent-skills/best-practices 

Have you built a Claude AI skill that feels inconsistent or seems to ignore your instructions? It might be because of recent, subtle changes to how Claude processes skills, like only reading the first 100 lines of a reference file. In this video, we'll dive into Anthropic's updated best practices and cover the essential rules you need to know to make your skills more reliable and effective across all models.

00:00 - Intro: Why Your Skills Are Failing
00:53 - #1: Content Lists
01:38 - #2: Degrees of Freedom
04:25 - #3: Test on Every Model First
06:30 - #4: Nested References
08:43 - #5: Using Checklists
09:58 - #6: Self-Correction Loops
10:50 - #7: Dependencies
